Matt Beall joins Danny Jones to present what the episode title calls the best proof yet of ancient machines in Egypt. The stones in question are about five thousand years old. Beall studies old sites and the marks left on hard stone.

Beall points to cuts, holes, and smooth faces in granite that he says hand tools could not make. He argues some lost group had machine tools far ahead of their time. Jones asks what would settle the fight between Beall and the experts who doubt him. Listeners get the strongest form of the claim, with the host pushing for proof at each step.
